claimCeiling: This machine-readable contract is a revision-9 design proposal. It is not an implemented validator, an execution approval, scientific evidence, a resource measurement, or SoftwareX readiness evidence.

headerLayout.display: ASCII SCF64L1 followed by one NUL byte; exactly eight bytes

sourceInventoryRegistry.entryOrder: strictly ascending by ASCII relativePath bytes
sourceInventoryRegistry.pathUniqueness: relativePath unique independent of bytes and digest
sourceInventoryRegistry.terminalPreservation: Every success and failure root retains the same ordered three immutable inventory locators declared before execution.

constraints.candidates: 1..2500 positive built-in integer lag indices, excluding booleans and floats; strictly ascending; greatest candidate < commonLength
constraints.replicateIdMapping: finite row at productionOrderIndex i has replicateId i for every i in 0..B-1

preDerivationEvidenceContract.rawInputBinding: A VERIFIED rawSourceEvidence contains rawInputLocator plus observedBytes/observedSha256 equal to completed N00 evidence. An UNAVAILABLE rawSourceEvidence preserves relativePath, nullable expectedIdentity, observedBytes if stat committed, null observedSha256, and a closed failure reason. Neither expected identity nor a partial hash is a verified actual digest.
preDerivationEvidenceContract.failedValueEvidenceRule: AVAILABLE retains observedType, encodedLengthBytes, nullable bitLength, and digest over the exact encoded value bytes. UNAVAILABLE retains its closed reason only; no value, type, length or digest is invented.
preDerivationEvidenceContract.knownPrefixRule: exactly one entry for every successfully committed predecessor node, in DAG order; no failed/current/later node
preDerivationEvidenceContract.reasonMapping: failure emitter and TerminalFailureCode must be a member of that normalization node operator's closed mapping

blockShuffle.orderRule: order is an exact permutation of integers 0..q-1
boundaryTests: q=4096 ACCEPT when all other constraints pass

recordRoles.PRODUCTION_REPLAY_ROW: immutable production finite replicate or exact-state component projection
recordRoles.COMPARISON_RECORD: two immutable record locators plus rebuilt FieldComparison values; no candidate vectors

terminalReachability.rule: Following each root's declaredRunGraph locator and the graph's canonical edges reaches every artifact emitted or retained by the run exactly once by artifactId. No orphan output is permitted.
terminalReachability.sourceInventoryRule: Both terminal roots preserve the same three declared source inventory locators in canonical role order.

declaredRunGraphRegistry.nodeIdentity: artifactId unique; artifactType and path slot immutable
declaredRunGraphRegistry.nodeTypeRule: Nodes may use every topLevelArtifactTypesInOrder member plus additionalMaterializedNodeTypes. The latter are graph slots for bound non-row artifacts, not extra top-level artifact-schema roots.
declaredRunGraphRegistry.terminalSelfHashCycleAvoidance: The approved graph is a pre-execution declaration of node ids, types, path slots and edges; it does not contain output digests. Terminal roots bind the declared graph artifact by immutable locator.

productionRunManifest.immutability: Canonical manifest and rows are content-addressed and never rewritten after verification.
productionRunManifest.observedProjection: Exactly one locator for finite resolved branches that have an observed scan; null otherwise.
productionRunManifest.replayProjection: Ordered locator array exactly matching finite replicate or exact-state order.
productionRunManifest.rootReachability: All observed and replay row locators occur in the declared run graph and are reachable from the terminal root.

requiredFieldPlanRegistry.reconstructionRule: The validator generates the unique plan from record role, terminal branch, C and q. It rejects empty, removal, duplicate path, reorder, extra path, and rule substitution before comparing values.
requiredFieldPlanRegistry.disagreementCodeOrderRule: Deduplicate encountered codes and emit them in ComparisonDisagreementCode.codesInSeverityOrder, never encounter order.

EXACT.match: same JSON type and same value; boolean is not integer

TAIL_EXACT.match: same boolean-or-null type and value; no tolerance

OPTIONAL_FLOAT_ABS_TOL.nullCases: both null match; mixed null/FloatHex does not match; residual fields are absent

FLOAT_ABS_TOL.inputs: two canonical finite FloatHex values and the fixed tolerance
FLOAT_ABS_TOL.overflowRule: OVERFLOW does not make comparison undefined; exact Fraction arithmetic decides matches without dependence on a decimal context, and residualHex is null.

exactOracleRegistry.identityContribution: identity is not included in E
exactOracleRegistry.E: count of nonidentity states whose inclusive-tail indicator is true

constraints: if observed valid and F==0 then pValueHex=lowerBoundHex=upperBoundHex and decision is defined
otherwise pValueHex and decision are null

definitions.candidateEvaluationOperationsExecuted: sum raw committed candidate-scan events across observed/reference/diagnostic domains
definitions.fieldComparisonObjectsPersisted: sum H(recordBranch,C,q) over completed comparison rows
definitions.diagnosticReplayCandidateOperationsExecu: sum per-group committed replay candidate events, including current partial group

boundaries: C=2500 ACCEPT when every other cap passes

executionDAG.branchResolution: No preflight, source, parse, schema, normalization or admission failure may carry a resolved primaryTerminalClass. Exact uses EXACT_BRANCH_UNRESOLVED and finite uses FINITE_BRANCH_UNRESOLVED until the designated commit event.
executionDAG.row01SourceIdentity: Source identity progress is a dedicated operator cursor and can be partial at any entry, byte offset, hash block or dependency index; it is never inferred from a completed count alone.

operatorCursorRegistry.atomicCommitRule: A counter increments only after its named atomic event commits. Cursor points to the next uncommitted event. On failure, committed counters plus cursor are the entire prefix; no summary inversion is permitted.

sortOccupancy.counterexample: one bucket (4,1) yields 8; one bucket (2,2) yields 4

comparisonAndDiagnosticRegistry.comparisonStorage: ComparisonRecord stores referenceRecordLocator, productionRecordLocator and exact FieldComparison values only. It never stores either candidate vector.
comparisonAndDiagnosticRegistry.diagnosticBijection: Each finalized DISAGREEMENT ComparisonRecord targets exactly one completed diagnostic group, and each completed diagnostic group targets exactly one such record.

countDefinitions.DStarted: count of diagnostic groups whose header row commit event occurred
countDefinitions.DCompleted: count of started diagnostic groups whose footer row commit event occurred
countDefinitions.ZExecuted: guarded sum of committed diagnostic row counts across every started group, including the current partial group
countDefinitions.diagnosticReplayCandidateOperationsExecu: guarded sum of committed candidate evaluation events across every diagnostic group, including the current partial group
countDefinitions.failureOnNextGroupOverCap: Before starting group 257, terminate with ADMISSION/DIAGNOSTIC_REPLAY_LIMIT and retain the comparison discovery prefix; never truncate disagreements and report success.
countDefinitions.partialByteCustody: Uncommitted partial-row bytes do not increase ZExecuted but remain in per-writer bytesWritten and retained-artifact evidence.

comparisonAndDiagnosticRegistry.diagnosticHeaderCounterUnion: Each header counter is the counterStatusUnion; missing, null-without-reason and value-with-reason are invalid.

jsonProfile.objectKeyOrder: ascending Unicode code point order after ASCII-only field-name check

escapeSafeStringUpper.algorithm: For an ASCII string domain, sum exact escaped UTF-8 byte costs per allowed byte: quote/backslash/control use JSON escape cost, other allowed ASCII uses one; add two quote bytes.
escapeSafeStringUpper.forbiddenShortcut: 2+maxCharacters unless every admitted byte is proven one-byte and non-escaping

dynamicMonotonicityTests: C=1 row upper < C=2 row upper for every candidate-bearing shape
q=2 block-state row upper <= q=3 block-state row upper
escape-heavy maximum key/value is within recomputed upper

byteAdmission.ledgerUpper: guarded sum of exact RowUpper(shape,env) occurrences
byteAdmission.fixedPointAlgorithm: start manifestBytes=0; recompute canonical manifest upper from decimal digit widths of all included byte totals until unchanged; require convergence within 32 iterations and monotone nondecreasing sequence
byteAdmission.failureReserve: failureManifestReserveBytes is included once in every pre-run package admission and may not be re-used by success bytes

resourceDAG.memoryEquation: phasePeakUpper=sum(namedComponentUpper for component in phase); globalPeakUpper=max(phasePeakUpper)
resourceDAG.candidateTransientRule: COMPARISON and DIAGNOSTIC_REPLAY include exactly 2*C candidate-record objects, never a persisted comparison candidate vector.
resourceDAG.runtimeLayoutBinding: Every named component byte upper is evaluated with the one approved runtime layout profile and exact runtime probe identity. Mixed profile ids are invalid.

durabilityRegistry.transitionRule: A state is entered only after the previous atomic operation commits. INSTALLED is synonymous with completed DIRECTORY_FSYNC, not completed RENAME.
durabilityRegistry.partialFileRule: A zero-byte retained partial is admissible only with disposition RETAINED_PARTIAL and digestStatus UNVERIFIED/null digest unless an empty-file digest was actually verified.

verificationOrder: stat and hash local approval bytes without parsing
require digest equals pinnedApprovalSha256 supplied out of band
load trust store by independently supplied identity
verify approver key/record and valid UTC decision
verify all ten ordered bindings byte-for-byte
only then allow APPROVED_FROZEN execution mode
approvalRegistry.bindingRule: Exactly one binding per role, in this order, with unique artifactId/path and exact bytes/sha256. Nested budget/runtime/source/root ids must equal these bindings; outer A plus nested B is rejected.
approvalRegistry.proposalContainmentRule: A PROPOSAL_UNAPPROVED terminal or graph may not embed or locate an APPROVED_FROZEN child. An APPROVED_FROZEN root requires every governed child to have the same approvalId and authority binding.

validationReportRegistry.passMeaning: Only the declared validation scope passed for the exact bound bytes; never scientific validity, approval, M6 execution, release, or SoftwareX readiness.

mutations: derive failed work from completed rows
terminal source inventories differ from declaration

importantAndBoundaryTests: ledger candidate count=100000 accept and 100001 reject
row upper C=1 to C=2 strictly increases
row01 partial source hash cursor is representable
zero-byte UNVERIFIED retained partial is representable
each top-level artifact root has a valid representative and is unique
each local oneOf branch is satisfiable
